tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /tshe dpag med kyi dbang chog bskyed rdzogs bzhugs so/ /bla ma dang mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/yid 'phrog mtshan dpe'i 'o
༄༅/ /tshe dpag med kyi dbang chog bskyed rdzogs bzhugs so/ /bla ma dang mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/yid 'phrog mtshan dpe'i 'o

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /tshe dpag med kyi dbang chog bskyed rdzogs bzhugs so/ /

bla ma dang mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ yid 'phrog mtshan dpe'i 'od spung 'khrigs pa'i sku/ /gdangs snyan drug cu'i sgra dbyangs sgrog pa'i gsung*/ /skyon bral yon tan mtha' dag rdzogs pa'i thugs/ rnam 'dren tshe dpag med la gus phyag 'tshal/ /'dir mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa mnyes par byed pa'i sgo du ma zhig mchis pa'i nang nas rje btsun grub pa'i rgyal mo nas dpal ras chung ba la brgyud pa/ dpa' bo gcig grub kyi rgyud du gsung pa'i sngags la brten nas dpa' bo gcig gi tshul du sgrub par byed pa/ rgya bod gnyis na 'gran zla dang bral ba'i tshe sgrub khyad par can 'di nyams su len pa la gnyis/ rang bsnyen sgrub kyis grol bar byed pa dang*/ gzhan dbang bskur gyis smin par byed pa'o/ dang po ni/ rang nyid kyang bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa las/ rab grub rgyal ma lha mang kyi dbang bzhi rdzogs pa 'am/ de ma thob na'ang 'di'i dgos kyi dbang rdzogs par thob cing dam tshig dang sdom pa dag par byas la/ 'khrid kyi man ngag nyams 'khrid kyi tshul du legs par thob par byas nas nyams su len pa la gnyis/ sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi'o/ /sngon 'gro la sdig sgrib 'dag par byed pa rdo rje sems pa'i sgom bzlas/ mos gus bskyed par byed pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor| tshogs gnyis rdzogs par byed pa maṇḍal gyi 'khrid rnams ni spyi dang mthun par zla ba phyed las mi nyung ba/ sdig pa dag pa dang tshogs rdzogs pa'i rtags byung byung gi bar du byas pas/ rgyud snod rung khyad par can bya'o/ /dngos gzhi la gsum/ bskyed rim dang*/ rdzogs rim dang*/ bcud len la rten nas tshe sring ba'o/ /dang po la bdag bskyed sgom pa dang*/ mdun bskyed la rten nas tshe sring ba'o/ / dang po ni/ 'gal rkyen dang bral zhing mthun rkyen 'dzom pa'i yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su rten dgram pa dang*/ mchod pa bsham pa la sogs pa byas nas stan bde ba la tho rangs bya rog skad ma grags pa'i dus su/

kha nub du phyogs pas dkyil dkrung la sogs pa'i bsam gtan gyi 'dug stangs dang mthun pas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed spyi dang 'dra ba byas la/ oṃ swabhā wa shuddhaḥsarba dhārmaḥswa bhā wa shuddho3 haṃ/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las padma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi sems kyi ngo bo yi ge hriḥdamar po de las 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus hriḥl thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid mgon po tshe dpag med sku mdog pad ma rā ga'i lhun po ltar dmar ba/ zhi ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa mnyam gzhag gi steng na 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa bsnams pa/ 'i mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ pad zlagadan la zhabs gnyis rdo rje dkyil dkrung gis bzhugs pa/ rin po che sna tshogs pas brgyan zhing*/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas bklubs pa/ 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phro ba'i dpral bar oṃ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ de las 'od 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sgom pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥganyis su med par thim par gyur/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis bdud rtsi'i bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba thogs te/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur bas| lus gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma spyi gtsug tu 'khyil ba yongs su gyur pa las dbang rtags ral pa'i cod pan la 'od dpag med sprul sku'i rnam pa can gyis dbu brgyan/ dbang gi lha thams cad gnyis su med par thim/ mchod pa chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa dngos su bshams pa'am med na yid kyis sprul nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ las byung ba'i mchod sprin ngo bo bde stong gi ye shes rnam pa mchod rdzas dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur/

oṃ bha ga wa ti a pa ra mi ta ā yur dzñā na sa pa ri wā ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin du arghaṃ gyi gnas su/ padyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhupe/ ā lo ke gandhe/ nai wi dye/ shapda rnams bzhag go /dri med bzhom bzhig bral ba chos sku'i ngang nyid las/ / thugs rje chen pos 'gro la rjes su chags pa'i tshul/ pad ma rā ga'i mdangs ldan dri med 'od 'bar ba/ /skyob pa mtshungs med tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo| |zhes dang*/ 'khor ba'i sems can ma lus pa/ khyod kyi mtshan tsam 'dzin pa la/ /tshe dang ye shes stsol mdzad pa'i/ /tshe dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo/ / zhes sogs dang*/ 'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med/ /ces sogs kyis bstod/ oṃ na mo bha ga wā te a pa ra mi ta ā yur dzñā na su bi ni shtsita te dzo rā dza ya/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arha te samyaksaṃ bungngha ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ puṇyai puṇyai ma hā puṇyai/ a pa ri mi ta puṇye a pa ri mi ta puṇye dzñā na saṃ bha ro pa tsi te/ oṃ sarba saṃ ska ra pa ri shungngha dharma te ga ga na sa muṅge te swā bha wā bi shungnghe ma hā nā ya pa ri wā ri swā hā/ zhes pa brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa bzlas nas| oṃ a ma ra ṇi dzī wānt+yai swāhā/ zhes pa yang brgya stong la sogs pa bzlas/ slar yang mchod bstod bya'o// gnyis pa tshe srog nyams pa gsos pa dang*/ phyi snod kyi yon tan bsdus pa dang nang bcud kyi yon tan bsdus nas tshe sring ba'o/ /dang po ni/ sngar rjes de nas/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing nas rgyal ba tshe dpag med la sangs rgyas byang sems kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ rang gi smin mtshams las mtho gang tsam gyi nam mkha' la bzhugs pa'i bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag med ces sogs thugs kar hūm̐ las 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros pa sangs rgyas byang sems kyis bskor ba'i dpral bar oṃ/

mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ sngar bzhin mchod bstod byas/ oṃ badzra ā yur ṣe sa ra he ka ra re sha ra re hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā zhes pa bdun gyis gsol ba btab pas hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rang gi tshe dang dbang thang la sogs pa rnams bdud dang gshin rje dang ma mo dang rgyal 'gong la sogs pas 'phrogs pa khyer ba yar ba thams cad sa dgu la sogs pa'i gnas gang na 'dug kyang rdo khab len gyis lcags rang dbang med par 'dren pa bzhin du/ 'od zer gyi sna la 'od dkar po'i rnam par nar drangs/ tshe dpag med kyi bum pa'i nang du byon/ zhu zhing khol/ 'chi med tshe'i bdud rtsir gyur/ bum pa'i kha nas skya zhal zhal lud nas rang gi spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga 'phang lo'i bu ga lta bu'i nang na mar la zhugs/ tshe 'khor ba thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nad gdon thams cad sangs kyis dag lus bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis mer gyis gang*/ tshe srog dbang thang thams cad legs par sor chud cing mos pa brtan zhing ting nge 'dzin gsal ba'i ngang nas a ma ra ṇi stong phrag bdun re tsam bzlas/ mchod bstod bya/ 'dod don la gsol ba gdab smon lam bkra shis bya/ mdun gyi tshe dpag med rang nyid la dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par bstim/ thun mtshams kyi bya ba la 'jug de bzhin du skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas bzung ste/ snga ma ji bzhin byas nas/ snga dro gung*/ phyi dro srod| nam gung*/ tho rangs te thun drug gi gung gnyis dang mtshams gnyis te thun gnyis su bcad nas dmigs pa dang bzlas pa sbrags nas dmigs thun de nyid la zhag gsum la sogs pa'am/ tha na'ang zhag gcig bya'o/ /de bzhin du dmigs pa 'og ma rnams la yang dmigs pa ngo bo spo ba ma gtogs/ bdag bskyed mdun bskyed sogs smon lam bkra shis kyi bar khyad par med par bya'o// gnyis pa la 'byung pa sa'i bcud bsdu ba ni mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams/

'og dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi dbus kyi ri rab lhun po/ gser gyi ri bdun gling bzhi gling phran ri gangs can la sogs pa'i gangs ri spos ngad ldan la sogs pa'i spang ri/ ma la ya la sogs pa'i nags ri ste/ mdor na sra zhing brtan pa sa'i khams thams cad la phog 'byung ba sa'i skrag dang*/ gzi brjid ro dang bcud nus pa thams cad rdo khab len gyis zhes sogs snga ma bzhin bya'o/ lus bdud rtsi bcud kyis mer gyis gang*/ khyad par 'byung ba sa'i yon tan bsdus pas rang gi lus sra zhing brtan pa rdo rje lta bu gang gis kyang gzhig cing bzhom par mi nus par gyur snyom du mos pas sngags bgrang ngo*/ /'byung ba chu'i bcud bsdu ba ni phyi dang nang gi dang 'og gi rgya mtsho dang chu gter ma dros pa dang chu bo chen po bzhi la sogs pa brlan zhing bsher ba chu'i zhes sogs nas chu'i bcud bsdus pas lus snum bag phun sum tshogs par ldan par bsam mo/ /me'i dkyil 'khor dang rta gdong gi me dang*/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la sogs pa tsha zhing bsreg pa me'i bdag nyid sogs nas/ me'i bcud bsdus pas lus bkrag mdangs dang gzi brjid phun sum tshogs par bsam mo/ /'og gzhi rlung gi dkyil 'khor la sogs pa yang shing g.yo ba rlung gi dkyil 'khor sogs dang*/ rlung gi bsdus pas lus stobs dang yang rtsal phun sum tshogs par bsam mo/ /gnyis pa la so so'i skye bo dang*/ nyan rang 'phags pa dang*/ sangs rgyas byams sems kyi yon tan bsdus nas tshe sring ba'o/ /dang po ni/ bdag mdun gsol gdab sogs sngar bzhin las/ phyogs bcu'i sems can bsod nams can thams cad khyad par tshangs pa brgya byin 'khor los bsgyur rgyal/ gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇḍi ta/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dpa' mo/ yang dgos ma gcig grub pa'i rgyal mo/ ti pu gsang sngags kyi sdong po| ras chung rdo rje grags pa/ rje btsun mi la ras pa sogs 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob pa'i gang zag khyad par can thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan dang 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thams cad sngar bzhin bsdus nas bsam gtan pas de rnams kyi yon tan thams cad thob par bsam mo/

/gnyis pa ni/ phyogs bcu'i nyan rang gi 'phags pa'i gang zag zung bzhi ya brgyad la sogs pa thams cad kyi yon tan zad par zil gnauon/ rnam thar snyoms 'jug la sogs pa thams cad sngar bzhin no/ /gsum pa ni/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyi mtshan dpe gsung dbyangs/ stobs dang mi 'jigs pa la sogs pa sngar bzhin no// rdzogs rim la rtsa 'khor dang*/ rlung sbyor dang*/ dbab bzlog la rten nas tshe sring ba gsum mo/ /dang po la dag byed stong par sgom pa/ rtsa 'khor gsal gdab pa/ nyi zlas lus dgang ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rang nyid tshe dpag tu med par gsal ba'i lus kyi nang thams cad phru ma phus btab pa bzhin du rnag khrag dang nang khrol la sogs ljan ljin gyis bral ba'i stong par yun ring du sgom mo/ /gnyis pa ni/ de ltar lus kyi nang stong pa'i sgal tshigs kyi nang rol du rtsa dbu ma kha dog dmar po/ sbom phra mda' smyug tsam yar sna tshangs bug dang*/ mar sna lte 'og sor bzhir slebs pa gdugs kyi yu ba lta bu'i dpral bar rtsa 'dab so gnyis/ mgrin par bcu drugasnying khar brgyad/ lte bar re bzhi rnams kha dog rim bzhin dkar dmar nag ser ba gnyis gnyis dang*/ kha sbyar lta bur gnas par bsgom mo/ /gsum pa ni/ dbu ma'i mar snar tshe dpag med dmar po mtshon gang pa shin tu mtshar ba bsgoms la sngar bzhin mchod do/ /gsol ba btab pas thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis sa'i bcud bsdus de'i bum par bya'o/ /bdud rtsi dmar po rgya mtshal lta bu 'phyur nas lte ba'i rtsa 'dab khengs par mos shing bde mer ba la sems bzung la sngags cung zad zlas/ de bzhin du snying kha/ mgrin pa| dpral ba rnams su rim gyis 'phyur bar mos la snga ma bzhin bya de nas yar snar tshe dpag med dkar po byas nas yas rim kyis rtsa 'khor khengs par mos pa la sogs pa snga ma bzhin bya'o/ /de bzhin du chu me rlung sogs bskyed rim ltar byas nas re re bzhin nyi ma yar 'bar ba dang zla ba mar 'dzag pa la sems 'dzin gtso bor bya'o/

gnyis pa rdo rje'i bzlas pa dang bum pa can dang*/ 'og rlung la rten nas tshe sring ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rang tshe dpag med du gsal bas lus gnad srang*/ rlung ro lan gsum la sogs pas gsal la/ rlung sna bug g.yas nas rgyu na bzhogs g.yas 'og du bcug nas cung zad nyal ba la sogs pa'i man ngag gis spos la g.yon nas rgyu ba'i nang du 'jug pa de brgya rtsa la sogs pa bgrangs nas 'byung 'jug gi dwangs par byas la/ nges pa na nang du 'jug pa oṃ/ gnas pa la āḥ phyir nar byung ba hūm̐ gi rang gdangs su mos nas yun ring du bzlas shing sems rtse gcig tu bzung ngo*/ /phyis 'di sna bug g.yas nas dang gnyis ka nas rgyu ba de bzhin du sbyar te/ zhib par zhal las shes te rlung sbyor gyi gtso bo 'di yin no/ gnyis pa ni/ 'og rlung lte 'og tu yar 'then/ steng rlung dal bus mar gnan nas lte 'og gi tshe dpag med kyi thad du kha sbyar yun tshad rab 'bring tha gsum ci nus zug mi bskyed tsam du legs par bzung zhing sems kyang de nyid du rtse gcig du legs par bzung la zug bskyed pa na dal bus lhag med du btang ngo*/ slar yang de bzhin du sbyar ba'i thun 'jog khar dal bus nang du rngubs nas rlung bzung te/ phyir rlung rang yal du btong ba man ngag go /gsum pa ni/ steng rlung 'dzin pa na 'og rlung so la 'jog steng rlung phyir btong ba na 'og rlung steng du cung zad 'dren pa/ de lta bu legs par 'byongs pa na 'og rlung 'dren pa'i tshe/ de'i rkyen gyis lte ba'i tshe dpag med kyi bum pa nas bdud rtsi dmar po byon pas lte ba'i rtsa 'dab khengs/ steng rlung bzung bas spyi bo'i dkar po byon rtsa 'dab khengs/ de bzhin dmar po mas rim dang dkar po yas rim kyis rang rang gi rlung gis drangs nas mthar dkar dmar 'dres pa'i bde ba dpag med bskyed par mos la rtse gcig du sems bzung ngo*/

/dbab bzlog ni/ rang tshe dpag med du gsal bas phyag rgya gos dkar mor gsal btab nas lus lha dang*/ ngag sngags dang*/ yid chos kyi 'du shes gsum dang ldan pas snyoms par zhugs pas lte ba'i tshe dpag med rjes chags kyi mchod pas mnyes pa'i bum pa nas dmar cha 'bar ba dbu ma nas song/ spyi bo'i tshe dpag med la mchod pas mnyes nas bdud rtsi dkar cha legs par babs pa rtsa 'khor bzhir rim gyis babs pas dga' ba dang*/ mchog dga' dang khyad dga' lhan skyes kyi dga' ba bskyed la stong pa dang sbyar dngos su babs nabazlog pa'i sbyor bas bzlog cing sems kyis lte 'og gi tshe dpag med kyi bum pa nas dmar cha slar yang 'bar ba dang lhan cig tu 'khor lo bzhi mas rim gyis gyen du song bas mas bstan gyi dga' bzhi rang bskyed pa las sngar bzhin bskyangs/ de nas dmar cha spyi bor 'dus pas gos dkar mo dmar mor gyur pas tshe dpag med 'khyud nas snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde bas mnyes/ sbyor mtshams nas bdud rtsi dkar po babs sngar bzhin yas babs dang*/ de'i dkar cha gos dkar mor gyur pas lte 'og gi yab la 'khyud cing snga ma bzhin byas pas mas bstan gyi dga' bzhi bskyed la bde stong yun ring du bskyang zhing*/ lus kyi zungs dang bde drod yun ring du rgyas par bya'o/ /de thams cad kyi rje thob thun las ldang ba'i dus kyi rnal 'byor ni gsum ste/ thog mthar tshe'i sgo sdoms/ dbus su tshe'i phur pa gdab/ phyin chad gdon gyi sgo dgags pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'gro ba'am 'chag la sogs rjes thob kun tu yang dbu ma'i yas sna mas sne'i tshe dpag med gnyis gsal btab na sems kyi ye ma yengs par dran 'dzin gyis bskyang bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ mar sna'i bum pa nas bdud rtsi'i bum pa yar lud pa snying khar sleb pa na nyi ma dang*/ yar sna'i mar babs pa snying khar sleb pa na zla ba ste/ gnyis ka sran ma phyed gshag tsam snying kha'i a wa dhū tī'i nang du ga'u kha sbyor du gyur pa'i nang du rang sems kyis ngo bo hūm̐ yig sngon por gsal bar bsgoms nas spyod lam la 'jug go

/gsum pa ni/ rang gi srin mdzub gnyis kyi rtsa'i rtsa ba nas rtse mo'i bar breng chags su hūm̐ dmar po me'i rang bzhin can rtseg mar gnas par bsgom mo/ rim pa 'di dag la zhag bcu gnyis bsgoms na lo bcu gnyis tshe sring bar grags shing*/ zla ba gcig bsgoms na nges par lo bcu gnyis tshe sring bar 'gyur ro/ /gsum pa bcud len ni/ spyir lus zungs ngan pa dang*/ khyad par rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa spyi ste bzhi rnams kyi gnyen por rim bzhin dbang lag ra mo sha rtag tu ngu*/ lcong zhi sman mchog rgyal po a ru ra gser mdog rnams cha mnyam nas/ ra mo sha'i khu ba legs par bsdus la dug dbyung*/ khu ba tshags ma la btsags la de'i nang du lcags bcug nas ma khol bar du me cher btang*| khol nas me chung la rgyun srings nas btang*/ skya ba'i kha la cung zad nar nar byung ba dang phog la grang su bzhug cong zhi me dang phrad pas 'dril ba bshig nas phye mar zhib du btags sbrang rtsi zhib du btags pa chang gar mas phol tsam du sbol/ dbang lag gi phye ma ba'i 'o mas nyin zhag gcig skyo tsha gar ma tsam du sbyar ba nang par 'khras pa de la gser mdog zhib du btags pa'i phye ma dang cong zhi'i phye ma btab la ran par mnye/ de ram nye'i khan ḍa dang*/ bu ram dang sbrang spra tshil med pa gsum bsres pa sbyar/ ri lu ri bong gi ril ma tsam byas| thod pa'i nang du blug la gdan gtsang ma'i steng du bzhag nas rang tshe dpag med du gsal bar bsgoms/ a mṛtas bsangs/ swā bhā was sbyangs stong pa'i ngang las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ a las thod pa'i nang gi dbus dang shar lho nub byang du rim bzhin/ hūm̐ bhrum̐ aṃ dzriṃ khaṃ rnams las byung ba'i mi dang*/ glang po che dang rta dang ba lang dang*/ khyi'i sha rnams la yi ge lngas mtshan pa dang*/ slar yang yi ge de lnga las byung ba'i byang sems drin chen rakta dri chu sha chen rnams la de lngas mtshan pa'i steng gi bar snang la oṃ dkar po/

āḥdamar po/ hūm̐ sngon po rnams yas rim kyis mtho brtsegs tu gnas pa las 'od zer 'phros rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol nas bdud rtsi dkar mer gyis khengs/ slar 'bru gsum gyi 'od zer gyis 'byung ba sa'i bcud bsdus nas bdud rtsi la thim par bsam zhing 'bru gsum brgya rtsa la sogs pa bzlas/ de bzhin du chu me rlung gsum dang*/ sems can dang nyan rang dang*/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi yon tan dang*/ khyad par dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams sbyor ba mdzad pa'i sbyor mtshams las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug nas 'bru gsum brgya rtsa la sogs pa bzlas pa'i ril lu la btab/ mthar 'bru gsum yang zhu nas 'chi med tshe'i bdudartsir bsam/ slar yang*/ de bzhin du skyar gyin byas nas/ zhag bdun nam lnga'am gsum la sogs par mtshams dam du bcad nas bdud rtsi sgrubs la ril lu gzhan gyis ma mthong bar byas la/ tho rangs kyi dus su ril lu bdun re sogs gang 'tshams pa bza'o/ /de lta bu'i dm-igs pa bzlas pa rdzogs rim bcud lon rnams la lo drug chig 'dril byas na 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par the tshom med gsungs so/ /gnyis pa gzhan dbang bskur gyis smin par byed pa ni/ rang nyid sngar bsnyen pa rdzogs pa'i tshe gzhan rjes su bzung dgos pa byung na/ chang rag mar dang spos sna tshogs sbyar ba'i zan gyi tshe bum kha dog dmar po rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang*| snod gas chag med par tshe chang blugs la mgul chings dmar pos brgyan pa me tog tshomabu'i steng du bzhag pa'i mthar mchod pa dang gtor ma bzhi dang bcas pa bshams/ rang nyid bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa ci 'grub byas nas tshe zan dang tshe chang bsangs sbyangs byas nas tshe dpag med du bskyed| ye shes dgug zhugs mchod bstod byas de nyid kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gyis 'byung bzhi sogs kyi bcud bsdus pas sngar bzhin du byas pa'i dmigs pa dang bzlas pa gang 'grub kyis mchod bstod gtor ma a kā ros phul/

gtor ma gnyis pa dgos kyi chos skyong dang gsum pa mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dang*/ bzhi pa gzhi bdag la phul nas slob ma khrus dang maṇḍal sngon du 'gro bas| kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /zhes sogs kyis gsol ba gdab cing don dran bzhin pas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs 'chi/ /zhes sogs kyis sdom pa bzung bar byed du bcug la/ slob mas bsangs sbyangs byas nas tshe dpag med du bskyed pa sngar bzhin byas pa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ gis mdun bskyed tshe zan dang tshe chang gi tshe dpag med ye shes pa dang tha mi dad pa slob ma'i spyi bor spyan drangs pa'i tshe dpag med de gnyis kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ gis bskyed rim kyi dmigs pa rnams ji bzhin dpon slob gnyis kas sgoms la re re'i 'jug tu tshe bum spyi bor bzhag nas/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ mgon po tshe dpag med kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ bdag gi rdo rje slob ma ming 'di zhes bgyi bar 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ tshe mi 'gyur ba'i rdo rjer gyur cig tshe mi shig pa'i g.yung drung du gyur cig tshe mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan du gyur cig oṃ badzra ā yu ṣe swāhā/ gsum la sogs pa dang*/ a ma ra ṇi brjod/ phun sum tshogs pa sogs kyi tshigs bcad re'am/ spro zhing longs yod na mang du yang brjod do/ mthar spyi bor tshe dpag med gnyis po bstim nas gsol gdab dang bkra shis bya zhing tshe zan dang tshe chang sbyin no/ /rje btsun mgon po tshe dpag med pa yis/ rang gzhan smin grol byed pa'i gdam pa 'di/ /lugs 'dis grol ba'i dam pa rnams kyi gsung*/ /go bde'i sbyor bas 'jug pa'ang bde bar ni/ /skad gnyis smra ba shes rab rin chen gyis/ /dge 'phel chos 'khor sgang du legs par bris/ dge bas 'gro kun tshe dpag med mgon gyi/ /go 'phang bde blag nyid du 'grub gyur cig

/ na mo gu ru we/ rgyal ba stobs bcu'i dbang phyug tshe dpag med/ /rgyal yum grub pa'i rgyal mo rnal 'byor ma/ /rgyal sras sngags kyi sdong po ti pu pa// rgyal yum sras bcas gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /snyan brgyud lam zab ston mdzad rdo rje grags/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul mi la rje/ ye shes zhabs kyi rnam sprul sgam po pa/ /sprul pa'i skyes mchog gsum la gsol ba 'debs| |lung rigs grub pa'i dbang phyug mtha' rtsa pa/ /klu sgrub rnam 'phrul 'bri khung rin po che/ /de sras thu bo spyan mnga' chos kyi rje/ /gangs can dpal mgon gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhas grub gdam pa'i mdzod mdzin yang dgon pa/ /thugs kyi sras mchog spyan mnga' rin chen ldan/ /sgrub la mchog tu thugs gzhol zur phug pa/ /sgrub brgyud bstan 'dzin gsum la gsol ba 'debs| |yang dgon rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul 'ba' ra ba/ /'jig rten bya bral bde legs rin chen dang*/ /mkhas grub chen po nam mkha' byang chad pa/ sprul pa'i skyes mchog gsum la gsol ba 'debs/ /mkhyen rab rab tu yangs pa'i nam mkha' la/ /thugs rje nyin mor byed pa'i 'od zer gyis/ /thub bstan gling bzhi'i mun sel chos kyi rje/ /sems pa chen po'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// srog gcod la sogs tshe yi 'gal rkyen spangs/ /rtsa rlung la sogs tshe yi mthun rkyen spel/ /dbang 'khrid la sogs tshe yi dngos grub stsol/ /tshe dpag med dang dbyer med zhabs la 'dud/ /ces sho lo ka re re nas 'chi med rig mdzin thob par byin gyis brlobs/ /tshe srog nyams pa sos pas bsrung 'khor grub// 'byung bzhi bsdus pas gzhal yas khang dang ni/ /bcud kyi yon tan bsdus pas lha tshogs grub/ /bskyed rim sgo nas tshe la dbang thob shog /rtsa 'khor la brten rtsa chad nyams pa sos/ /rlung sbyor gsum gyi las rlung nyes skyon bsal/ /dbab dang bzlog pas bde chen 'chi med grub/

/rdzogs rim sgo nas mchog gi lam thob shog /de lta'i lam zab sgom pa'i lus kyi rten/ /bcud len mchog gi stobs dang bde ba 'phel/ /'phral dang yun gyi sdug bsngal kun spangs nas// tshe dpag med mgon go 'phang myur thob shog /ces pa 'di yang lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sbyar ba'o// //
